text: Worst place I ever eaten never eat there again. Got a pizza and wings the wings are the worst wings ever had in my life and the pizza was cold and it sucked.

I had been in the previous Da Sesto's restaurant and it was quite good.  I have to say this time was a big disappointment.  

I brought a number of friends and they too were disappointed.  The service was ok, but the food left a lot to be desired.  Friends split spaghetti and meatballs had 3 drinks and were charged extra for not having ice in their glass, having an olive and a split plate charge.  Their bill was $80 and they said they had better for a lot less.  Several of us had linguini and clam sauce and were charged an extra $1 for having garlic in it.  Excuse me but it's supposed to be prepared with garlic.  The Caesar  salad had anchovies which also resulted in an extra charge.  Others that had wine were overcharged for their wine as well.  It was a case of being nickle and dimed to death  for a mediocre meal.  Somebody else had cappuccino for $10 or $11 . 

If you are going to charge extra for every little thing it needs to be on the menu or the servers needs  to tell you.  Instead they were pushing the extras like it was part of the price.  Very bad experience for food that was only fair.  I felt terrible that all the people I brought were so disappointed.  BAD PR for sure. Just don't know what happened to this place since they moved next door.  Probably the last time I will go there.

Has to be a money laundering scheme going on for how long this place has been open because the food ain't it. I recommend taking the money you would spend on this dog s*** excuse of breakfast food, wiping your a** with it, flushing it down the toilet....and your money would still be spent better than wasting it on this place. Can't believe how long they took to even serve the food in the first place. Tasteless, cold, undercooked/overcooked. My wife's spinach and artichoke smelled like someone shat on the plate first. Waffles on Maple, you suck.

Great food. Our server Jennell is the best server in Tampa. Love her, ask for her.
Ask server for recommendations  on food and beer, she will help you.

The workers here didn't appear clean, as there were 2 guys and they wore gloves, but still questioned their hygiene!  My kids each ordered a gyros, which they said was greasy.  Also, seemed pricey for what you got, just not too happy with anything!

I was dying to try this place - missing moms cooking and all - and was encouraged by the artichokes and braciole on the menu.  I was disappointed first in the size and the layout of the tables.  There were no other diners there at the odd time we went and yet when we asked if we could sit at a larger table by the window we got a "No."  (there was no one else there when we left either - too early)  The menu looked great but pricey.  I ordered ravioli and braciole.  The braciole was close but a little t tough.  The ravioli was watery and tasteless (like frozen).  The gravy was very good but I asked if I could buy some to take home and the answer was just a flat  'No".  

All that said I really wanted this to be a good experience, and it wants to be, but maybe get some Italian servers in there...  or at least servers who say yes and get it - ie available, attentive, and accommodating.

Pretty disappointed with my most recent visit here. I live on HI so it's pretty convenient for drinks and dinner. Due to COVID I get the limited interactions, but to serve food with no plastic ware, napkins or condiments? You basically get a to go box and call it a day! Ordering is done via QR code which was fine. We got our food in a timely manner with no drinks insight, which we order through the app. We had to go to the bar and pickup our drinks (which the bartender didn't even know we order anything), napkins and plastic ware. Come for the view, live music and a beer.

Very, very cool place! Although difficult to find, you must visit the Patterson house if you are in the Nashville area! The Patterson House, is quite literally "a house" on the corner of a street. I love that everyone MUST be SITTING at the bar to participate in the experience. I hate when people are standing and hovering around me at a bar. The bartenders are true mixologists here. You give them a few examples of drinks and flavors that you like and then they come up with some concoction that tastes absolutely divine. I'll be back here for sure!

Edible but forgettable. I was about to walk out of Reading Terminal hungry because nothing in there appealed to me. But then, out of the corner of my eye, I spotted this Jamaican food shop. Excited, I stopped in my tracks and joined the line.  While my taste for Jamaican food has been compromised  because I am in LOVE with Flames's jerk chicken in Boston, and BK9 in NYC, I thought I'd give this place a shot. The food here was just okay. Edible but forgettable. I paid $27 for small oxtails (4 pieces coated in white, sticky fat), rice, cabbage, and a soda. I gave it three stars because after I removed the fat from the oxtail (a little gross), I found the food somewhat edible. Not the most flavorful, and not something I will eat again. I did not finish the dish and gave the majority of the platter to my doggies.  However, I am happy to finally see a Caribbean food spot in Reading Terminal. I am still in search for an unforgettable Jamaican food experience in Philly.

This place is an institution of Goleta / Santa Barbara. Try out their secret menu like the chili cheese dog. It's fantastic. 
If you think In N Out is good, you've never been to The Original Hamburger Habit. Pound for pound some of the best beef patties in town, any definitely the most affordable of the places in town that serve real beef patties, char broiled.

Believe it or not today was my first time ordering delivery since sheltering-in. 

After discovering Hot Ones on You Tube, because that's what happens when you've been homebound for 6 weeks, I decided today was a perfect day for some hot wings and.....Wingstop is not only nearby but also offering free delivery.

Online ordering was simple. My cousin and I got a 30 piece meal. We were able to mix classic and boneless, pick three flavors and three dipping sauces. It came with large fries and veggie sticks. 

Once the order was placed I was updated via text on the progress. My delivery driver Stephen was protected and polite. Everything was well packaged.

The bone-in classic hot wings were the best. The lemon-pepper, were lemony but a bit too salty and the Hawaiian were pleasant and sticky. The fries were limp, oily and disappointing. Solid experience overall.

I would never have noticed this place had a friend not recommended. It is a strange spot for an independent and yummy restaurant (tucked under the Chipotle and Verizon store). It was delicious takeout. Everything we ordered was a flavorful hit. Post-pandemic we will eat there and order more adventurously (like variety of whole fish options) but we will definitely go back for takeout.
Great food every time!!! Love this place. the lechon plate and Cuban sandwich are musts! They also recently expanded and its super nice & spacious. Dining in or Easy takeout as well.

We were excited to come to New Hope and sit outside and eat on a Wednesday. Unfortunately our experience was less than what should happen. First we were sat at a table awkwardly (we were 3) which for spacing would be fine however none of the other tables had the same rules so defeats the 6 feet apart rule that was told why we were sat in a row. Next our server, Jason was impatient and was not attentive. Watching how many table tops he had, it was half the other servers so being busy was not the excuse. The food choices are ok but for the prices, quite expensive for what you get. We placed our drink order and food order and the food took a bit of time and every time Jason went by, he never looked up or gave us an update. Finally when food arrived, we asked for a 2nd order of drinks. He said ok. We finished our meal, When he saw our food was done, he comes over and says  "Done?". I say you can cancel our drink order. Now this was what got us - Instead of apologizing, clearly he forgot, which anyone can do, - without missing a beat, he says "oh the bar is backed up". He blamed other employees and doesn't even apologize. Now what's funny, he brought the bill over at rapid speed. We had an over $100 bill for lunch so there was no reason to have such poor customer service, though everyone should  be awarded courteous service.  In today's climate, we've experienced absolutely amazing customer service - this was not only disappointing but also reminds why  no restaurant can rely on v
I've had the pizza a few times since and it wasn't overloaded with oregano. Probably just a mistake the first time. This is actually my favorite place for  pan pizza now.

I have been in New Orleans many a time and have enjoyed MANY a beignet so let's just be honest. These aren't the best I have tasted. I think that they were rushed because they were fried too hard, I understand that it was a VERY busy day due to true fact that it was Easter Sunday but good business is good business... because if you skimp on the process no one is going to want to come back.. when we got there the line was fine but it definitely got longer as we sat there.. 

The ambiance of the place is what makes it good, they have someone there playing live music and giving you that jazzy great feeling!!!

Come by International Mall food court and check out the latest edition! Aussie is offering your favorite flavors of its mama restaurant Outback in a speedy setting. I enjoyed the apple arugula salad with grilled chicken which was very tasty and a reasonable $7. Service was very friendly here and even though it took a little bit longer than maybe some of the other joints to get my food, I felt like it was worth it because it was healthy and flavorful. I do want to mention that the chicken is heavily seasoned, basically blackened, which I loved but my friend found to be too spicy. So if you don't like spicy, you might want to opt for the crispy chicken instead. The house dressing is Greek style and made fresh. 

I would eat here again and look forward to trying other menu items.

Pretty cool little sandwich spot in the heart of Safety Harbor. Was honestly expecting a lot more and left quite disappointed. The sandwiches were great don't get me wrong, but quite overpriced for the quality. Nothing out of this world. I had The Main Beef which was cheddar bread  with roast beef and cheese. Nearly $12.00 for two little slices. The dining area is quite small and feels a bit claustrophobic with everyone together in such a tight space. I'm also not sure why they pair their sandwiches with cut-up green apples on the side? The sandwich menu is not diverse at all which was a bummer. I wish they had more options. When the drink menu is a lot bigger than food menu, something's up. I was expecting a lot more based on the reviews.

If you aren't familiar with Frenchy's , they are a Clearwater Beach fresh seafood icon. No trip to the central Florida gulf coast is complete without a stop to one of the Frenchy's locations. You used to have to brave the traffic out to Clearwater Beach when the craving for a grouper nugget basket or she crab soup (do NOT miss-- it is possibly the best soup you will ever eat) hit, but now, all you have to do is head to the Dunedin Causeway (be sure to take the very short drive before or after your meal). The fish is fresh off the boat delicious and comes any way you can imagine it. And the outdoor setting, while by a major road, still manages to capture that "Ahhhh, I'm in Florida" vibe. They also have plenty of non-seafood options for that person in your group who just doesn't do seafood. Frenchy's does everything right to deserve its stellar reputation.

Loved this place! Had the vegan taco salad (get the queso cheese!) and a side of house chorizo. Wow, the best vegan taco salad I think I've ever had. And the chocolate cake and black iced tea were great too. Aces.

Our daughter introduced us to this place a while back and we returned yesterday on a visit to Reno. Wowee! Great cheesesteak brisket sandwich, smothered in grilled onions, and yummy potato salad. It's all takeout right now, thanks to the pandemic, but we sat outside at a table with an umbrella for shade and all was excellent. Friendly staff and great food -- can you ask for more? Oh, and go hungry! Portions are very generous!
Such a cute vibe! Loved the unique book decor. Great food & friendly staff. Would recommend making a reservation before going!

I love Donuts. 

I'd drive and have driven 40+ Miles ... hmmm, actually 80 miles round trip for a good donut. Shameful I know. 

If it's Cake or Donuts - I'm going Donuts.
Cookies/Ice cream/brownies or donuts - Donuts. 

See where i'm coming from ? 

So, I was damn confused on how I've lived up in the far NE for more than 2 decades and I've never heard of this shop before. 

Yelp knows what's up though.

I finished working out at OTF and then shot over here to grab some donuts for my boys... well, mostly for me but don't tell them that. 

The owner was such a nice person. We talked kids, Life and a bit of history of her donut shop...Felt Like I've known her for years. Really cool cat.

I appreciated how she gave a bakers dozen and
I also dug the interior of the place - It reminded me of a donut shop from my childhood. 

Unfortunately, the donuts weren't too good.
I could taste the oil that the donuts were fried in ... Dirty oil :/ 

That flavor was pretty much present in each donut. 

I don't have the heart to give 2 stars so it is what it is ... 3 stars.

I plan on stopping in again sometime. 
Yum Yum's is just too damn good to skip though...

I walked up and waited for the hostess to check-in, two women walk up after me. A gentleman comes out of the bar area and immediately ask the women if they had a reservation, their response was no. He then asks me and I advised yes and provided him with the time. I waited a little bit and a woman comes out and directs the two women that walked up after me with no reservation to a seat. I objected to having been there first and with a reservation. The woman says she will seat me next. Why? I don't know and would hope that it wasn't because of the color of my skin. We had two waitresses that were cool and the only reason why I didn't take my money elsewhere. The food was not terrible, but just ok. I would not go back.

Stopped here for a meal after a party across the street.  I ordered the corn beef hash breakfast.  Everything was great except for the grits.  They were too bland and watery.  Wife had pancakes and eggs, stating also excellent except the grits.

My wife and I decided to go out for a nice dinner before picking our kids up from the airport from a one month vacation with their sister. We've been to Del Frisco's before love the food service is up to par. But the experience we had this evening was nothing less than amazing. Brady our server was the best server we've ever had there. 5stars all around. Would recommend to have Brady serve you and time you go.

I am traveling for work and was in Newark for a few days.  The food was awesome and the service was excellent.  So much so the staff remembered me and they were really attentive.

I had the Ramen one evening and then the other time I had the Singapore noodles and dumplings.

This would be the 4th Ruth's Chris Steakhouse we have experienced, the 2nd in a Hotel/Casino environment, we eat there 3-4 times a year, normally it is a 2-3 hour drive.  Having one within a 30 minute drive was exciting. The overall experience was very good and would have rated a 5 star if not for the initial negative experience with the hostess Karlee.  We arrived approximately 20 minutes early, made contact with the hostess (Karlee) and advised we had a reservation.  She promptly advised they would call us at the reservation time, so no problem we would go wait in the bar.  That is where the unexpected happened, Karlee stopped us and stated "we are controlling who goes in the bar" at which point she went after two guests that proceeded into the bar ahead of us. The bar had ample available seating, so not sure why she responded this way. She returned shortly after making contact saying that they were going somewhere else.  As we told the other hostess we would wait for our reservation at the bar across from the restaurant, she said we could wait in their bar. We were both surprised that a business would want to have customers spend money somewhere other than their business. Once in the bar Neal the bartender was very attentive and quickly got us our drinks.  The bar is open to the lobby area, with a stanchion partially blocking an entry/exit point. At our reservation time a different hostess got us and we proceeded to our table.  The decor of the dining area is nicely update

Great place if you want to cook your own steak, Lol. Seriously, they bring your steaks out on super hot stones and the meat cooks on them to your delight. 
We tried their fish taco and MOAS (Mother of all Sandwiches). Both were tasty and their sweet potato fries are served with a honey dip (yummy).  I recommend for a special dinner with that special someone. Moderate- high priced and if you come during happy hour, you can save some cash.

Not my favorite place the menu is ridiculous with options hundreds of them actually.  I like quality better than quantity.  By having all these options you are force to
Sacrifice quality and use a good deal of canned non fresh options.   I had chicken and waffles was good not
Great .   The chicken fingers were standard frozen.   The other person had an omelet which was just ok the veggies felt frozen and not fresh.   By the people waiting outside the restaurant is a pleaser.   Judge for yourself.

We tried their Saturday family meal for 4 tonight. We chose the chicken fajitas for $25. I couldn't believe how much food was included. 

Chicken, with sauteed peppers and onions, rice, beans, sour cream, cotija cheese, guacamole. Pico de gallo was supposed to be included but we didnt receive which was fine bc the entire meal was $25. The included guac and cotija were in small amounts but for $25 we couldn't ask for more and I would be willing to pay for more cotija and more guacamole next time. We even had food leftover and we are 4 adults who were eating. 

That's a better price than I could cook the same meal with all the separate ingredients myself.  The food was also delicious. 

You can also get beer in bottles and growlers as take out which is nice for next time.  We will definitely eat here again, and once restrictions on eating in restaurants are eased, I will eat here in person as well.

Sardina's is an authentic Sicilian bistro that serves up traditional dinner choices using locally sourced ingredients. I've been here at least twenty time now, and have yet to receive anything less than great service and delicious food.

My favorites are Sardina's Salad (Summer Salad is also phenomenal!), Chicken Saltimbocca, and Susan's Traditional Lasagna. There's a bar with good selection of wine, beer, and spirits. Seating is ample, but it's good to call ahead for a reservation. Take out is available.

I highly recommend you check out this well-kept local secret.

Been to Namese three times now and can say with confidence it's a solid spot. First time we loved it, second time was iffy but tonight confirmed it's some of the best pho in the city. Meatballs are top notch along with the brisket. If I'm being honest, the place feels a little dirty upon close inspection, but not docking too many points. Tasty food makes up for a lot.

I am a relatively new resident to the area and has frequented Tavolino a lot and have only run into great employees and awesome food.  This weekend was the first time I was rather sad entering the restaurant.  My friend and I were turned away when ordering take out.  An employee, who wasn't very kind, looked at us and rudely said "obviously we are not doing take out tonight."  I go really?  And she said, "yes, we're full."  That doesn't make sense since if we were going to eat in -they would have served us.  It made me really sad.  :(
Huge portions , cool ambiance and delicious food , must come here for some yummy homestyle breakfast.

I saw the lower star review and decided to give it a try anyway. And we through it was great! Filet was tender and delish. The Alice springs chicken was tender and very good . The bread was warm and the service was 5 star!

We visited this restaurant on a Sunday morning for breakfast (they were actually serving a brunch menu though). They open their doors at 8am but they don't actually sit anyone in the dining room until 9am, essentially only bakery items are available during that one hour. They make all of their bakery items in house and they all look really good. The place is beautifully decorated with so much attention to detail everywhere. There's inside and outside seating but if they open up the dividing glass doors the place becomes one cozy yet airy, relaxing and inviting space. 

They have a counter at the front where people can sit and order food. That's also where the coffee drinks are made and where the bakery items are displayed. I was here once before just at the counter on a busy weekend afternoon and it took forever for someone to acknowledge me or even assist me with a to-go coffee drink. If you're interested in bakery items and/or coffee from the counter you better go early in the morning before the crowds arrive. Also, do not order their frappe unless you want to be served a disappointing weak latte. 

We opted to have their egg scramble dish (strapatsada) which is made with caramelized onions, roasted tomatoes and served along a small piece of baguette. At first glance it seemed like a small amount of food, but the dish was actually pretty filling and tasty. We also had the greek yogurt with granola, fruit and honey. It was a nice, sweet compliment to our breakfast. 

Their c

This is my new favorite brewery in town. The patio outside is inviting and spacious with umbrellas for when the sun is too hot! Great location for pups, kids, and group hangouts. They had lots of board games! The beer is great too. We had the Pale Ale that was on special and were not disappointed. The owners are attentive and friendly which gave it a small town feel. The food options were limited but absolutely delicious so we didn't mind. I got the pork sandwich and IT WAS SO MARVELOUS. I would definitely recommend!

Excellent BBQ! I travel a lot (airline pilot), and I'm a huge BBQ fan. I've had it all over the States, and this is some of the best I've had. I had the baby back ribs, wonderfully dry rubbed and smoked. I normally ask for ribs "dry", not slathered in sauce. I forgot to do so today at Sugarfire, but thankfully that's how they serve them. Rest assured, they aren't actually dry..they we're moist & tender and delicious without sauce. That's the gold standard for ribs. You have 5 sauces at the table to choose from if you want. I loved the Honey Badger sauce! I would have brought home a bottle, but they were out. My sides we're also excellent..creamy, peppery Cole slaw, and delicious collard greens. Washed it down with some of the best lemonade I have ever tasted. I will definitely be back!

It's exciting for a new place to eat on the Westbank, as it was getting old eating at the same places repeatedly. I was pleasantly surprised with the ambience and service. We were seated quickly and it was fairly busy for a Saturday night. The waiter came to the table right away to offer drinks and fill our water glasses.  This place was fully staffed and all the staff were superb and attending to the needs of all the guest. Yet most importantly the food was amazing. We tried the Chili Naan bread , Chicken Tikka Marsala and the Lamb Tikka Marsala with roti to finish off the sauce. Both Tikka dishes were served with rice. When we were done one of the waiters came to the table with a complimentary dessert. It was some type of sweet carrot mixture , like an Indian version of carrot cake , and it was very delicious. The menu has a large selection of authentic Indian cuisine. It's definitely worth a try if you are in the area. Sorry I didn't take any pictures , but trust me the food is great here and the atmosphere is inviting.
This place is disgusting and manager calls the employees sluts and whores if he didn't like them. Place will be shut down soon.

This is always my go to place. I like their food and the prices are good as well. I only wish that the server would wear gloves. I said that the service was good and the server was nice. Will definitely go again!

Valeria's was SO much better. I have tried to give Fito's numerous chances, but the food just isn't good. Bland Mexican (Americanized Mexican) food? If Taco Bell is beating you in the Mexican food game you might need to fix some things. I would not recommend.

Absolutely worst service I've ever had. Called 2 times to place an order for pickup, as the restaurant was right next to our hotel. I was put on hold for over 10 minutes twice, then decided to walk down there and place my order--thinking the restaurant was just busy. Walked down there to see only two people at the bar and about three tables occupied. I placed my order with the lady in front (she was very nice) and sat at the bar to wait for my order. I thought I might have a beer while I wait. The bartender didn't even acknowledge my existence and kept walking right past as I signaled to him--nothing. To sum it up, I was literally trying to give this place more of my money and couldn't even be acknowledged. As I looked around the bartender was only serving an older man who was a retired nfl player and a young woman who I sat two chairs over from. To top it off, the pizza wasn't cooked all the way through as well. Never again will I step one foot into this establishment.

Go here...Food was made by people who both love food and care what customers want.  Portions were VERY generous, which is a good thing because it was DELICIOUS.  You could taste the freshness of the ingredients; vegetables, spices, bread, fruit, and meat.  Service is a work-in-progress, but it felt like a family made up of the WHOLE community was making EVERY effort to make you feel like you wanted to be part their success story.  My favorite part was the mural art on the walls, lending a fresh, current, and fun atmosphere.
So amazing! Too good, couldn't take pictures fast enough! Delicious breakfast sandwich and cappuccino!

This place is awesome. I've ordered from here a few times and I've never been disappointed. The shrimp burger has a sauce on it that's nicely spicy and the fish and chicken is hot, crispy and delicious. $5 Friday meals get you either a catfish sandwich or a leg quarter. For $2.50 more you can get a side. I did curbside pickup today and it was right on time. Love this place and glad to have good fish and chicken in Franklin.

Well I can't say these were the best tacos I've ever had but they were pretty good and worth me coming back again. I've driven by this place multiple times and didn't even know it was there. It's pretty hidden but I'm glad I was able to find it. The menu definitely looks good and filled with other things I'm going to have to come back and try on my next visit. I came just before lunch time so thankfully it wasn't too busy. The food was also prepared pretty fast which was a plus. I ordered the 4 tacos for $10 and a pineapple Jarrito. I had one pollo, two steak and one pastor. My favorite was the pastor. All of the tacos are filled with plenty of meat. My only criticism would be the dryness of the meat. But overall still pretty good. I'm glad I decided to give this place a try for Taco Tuesday!!!! Definitely worth checking out if you're in the Armenia area.

Ate here yesterday, great honey BBQ wings. The facilities were clean and had very friendly staff. I really enjoyed the outdoor dining area. I spent about 13$ on a full meal and wing combo. Totally worth it.

The incredibly lovely man at the cash register said "everything is good here!" I asked a lady in line and she said "everything is good here!" By the time we left we were saying "everything is good here!" Such a great and fun experience.  Enjoyed free cake and flan just because he liked us. We liked him too! I was a little disappointed at first that it was not a sit down and be served restaurant. Well, it sort of is and the salsa bar is the bomb!
We love Hattie B's hot chicken. It's one of our favorites. The only down side is there's very little parking and during certain times of days there's a line out the door.

This is a really good Mexican restaurant in the neighborhood! I would take my friends and family.

I placed an UberEats order for 3 Pastor Tacos and a Tamal. I did put a note to not add onion to my tacos but when I received them they had onion (main reason for the ding). The tamal was also warm when it arrived, but it was cold by the time I finished my tacos. I felt like the tamal was too dry (but again, it was cold when I started eating it).

I was very impressed with the flavor of the marinated pork, and 3 tacos for less than  10, you can't beat it.

I ordered from here for Sonoran Restaurant Week after seeing their BOMB pre-fix menu. It was difficult to choose just one place from all offering Sonoran Week specials but "The Hub" knew just what flavors to target for those of us foodies on The hunt for food we don't often have a selection of in Tucson... that or the fact I liked the dessert options and saw their delicious mac&cheese was on the menu.. anyway, my husband and I called for pick up and ended up waiting even longer once there. It was kind of a longer wait but that's expected on a weekend evening downtown right, what can you do‍?! We didn't mind. The staff was very friendly and they were playing Saturday Night Live, no complaints here! When we got to the food at home, we had what felt like a feast! The food was delicious! My only gripe is that I forgot to tell them (& wasn't asked) how we wanted our steaks cooked as I would have chose something different. That and the burnt cookie I was looking forward to enjoying the dessert with. Nonetheless it did not take too much away from a fantastic meal! Good job HUB!
Nice little retro cafe, good standard breakfast with very knowledgeable friendly waitresses.  Not large but was seated very quickly.

What a great little restaurant! I have a food allergy to SOY. The owner took our orders, he was very careful about my food allergy to soy. The menu was small but most of the menu options were soy free. Unfortunately I couldn't try the falafel as the fryer oil is soy but my wife said the falafel was amazing. The owner said he made it fresh from scratch. I ordered the kebab plate which came with good portions of Israeli salad, hummus, tahini, grape leaves and pita. The kebab meat was cooked perfectly and it was tender and delicious and there was plenty! I also had some Turkish Coffee at the end which was excellent. Everything was delicious! The owner was very friendly and provided great hospitality. I'll be going back again and again now that I found a very friendly little Israeli restaurant with such delicious food! Don't let me forget, the pita bread was also very high quality! Highly recommend!

My friend and I were downtown during the evening and they ended up introducing me to this place and I cannot stop coming again! I would recommend it!

If you want chicken, this is the place to get it! Their fried chicken is great and I love the flavor options -- you can't go wrong with any of them. In particular, the Onion Lover, G.P Cheese, and Cilantro Lime are super interesting but honestly, all of them are good so it depends on what you are craving during your visit. Honestly, I felt that whatever you end up ordering, it'll generally be good. There are so much good options on the menu that you are more likely than not find something that sounds good to you personally.

The chicken itself was absolutely delicious: it was oh so crispy and super tender. By far the best value on the menu is the 5 pc Chicken SET for $11. It comes with chicken, a half-size salad, your choice of fries or corn fritter, and a can of pop. The value that comes from this combo is amazing.. it definitely beats any fast-food chain at that price-point.

I usually order the G.P Cheese or Onion Lover flavors. The G.P Cheese is heavy-loaded and very rich. I felt that it was super cheesy, garlicky, and flavor-packed! The Onion Lover, on the other hand, is pretty straightforward; it's in the name: if you like onion then this is a very good option. The sweet-hot mustard sauce that it comes with also pairs very well in terms of flavor but I found it a bit too watery.

When you arrive at Seoul Fried Chicken, ex

We had never tried this food truck/restaurant before this weekend. We pulled in to the small parking lot, got out to peruse the menu, and ordered our the items. I was excited to see that they had a keto option which was lower in carbs. We ordered two different tacos on corn tortillas and my keto one. It seems there might be a more efficient way of getting orders taken, paid, and delivered than what they did, but I realize that covid19 has made everyone do things differently than they normally would. Since we weren't in any hurry, it was ok that it took quite awhile before we actually had our food in hand. My husband enjoyed his tacos, but I really enjoyed my cheese shell shrimp taco. Several pieces of shrimp topped with cabbage, cilantro, and pick de Gallo all in a thick fried cheese shell. The mild sauce on the side was still too spicy for my tastes, so I ate it without. It was a fun, new adventure for us.
Help is friendly and takes the time to make you feel like a local.  Definitely a bar that serves meals.  Waitress was Sharon and she was great.  Stick to bar food, do okay.  Drink prices are fair.

Been coming to the Marsh Road location for years. Can never go wrong with a chicken burrito bowl. One of my favorite meals! Make sure you get the chipotle ranch dressing - so good. There is usually a line but totally worth the wait. The staff is also very friendly. We love El Diablo

Didn't expect it but, The Camellia Grill was definitely cool. The prices are very moderate as well. Pretty much every menu item that we have purchased was really fresh and delicious. I became very good friends with the staff, who are all wonderful and super welcoming. The Camellia Grill, I love it so much.

Ordered some sandwiches via Postmates and they were great. Quality bread and other ingredients. Taking out in person would save you a few bucks, so consider that if you live close and order often. We've been getting food from Goose The Market a few times and it's been consistently good.
Great atmosphere very clean little sushi restaurant. Probably one of the best sushi places I have ever been. Highly recommend kens special volcano roll

We went here this weekend to take part in their devour deal which was fantastic! It was so good and am very pleased with the variety as someone who doesn't eat much beef, the poultry options were incredible as well as the array of sauces! The fried Brussel sprouts were incredibly tasty and well cooked! Had the gnocchi as an appetizer and it was a great addition to the meal! Can't wait to go back! All the tables were spaced apart and masks being worn!

Was at Crispy Edge for my first time for a private event where we rented the whole restaurant.  I've had their potstickers so many times at pop-ups around town and somehow never made it in to Crispy Edge (what is wrong with me!?)

CE did a great job having everything set up ahead of time -tables, chairs, the coat rack in place, and brought the hot food out just before our planned lunch time so it was all fresh and warm!  They made a variety of sides, sauces, and of course, potstickers!  I was impressed with their ability to maintain the consistency and food quality I am familiars with from them for our large party (we filled the restaurant).  CE offers a full bar, and local coffee and tea (blueprint and London tea room respectively). 

I would certainly do another private event here and have to make it back for their normal business hours!  Can't wait

I have been here a few times pre-COVID, and the food and service were always mediocre at best. But their total disregard for mask and social distancing regulations has displayed a complete lack of care for the cool springs community (to which I am a native), and for that I will never come back. Do better. Be better people.

i really enjoy this place! i personally am a fan of their hot honey pizza here... so delicious. and the variety of their fountain sodas are amazing, all organic! 

my only tip is that during lunch time it gets pretty crazy so definitely be ready for it to be crowded

"The Eccentric"  So good and the company was even better. Definitely be willing to try something different . Plenty of choices for beer as well. (Tip: if your meeting up with a friend double check which location lol! There all good though )
It's one of the best coffee shops in Indy!! It's the perfect cup and they have lots of milk alternatives and pastries that are delicious!!

I'm so glad we checked this place out! I have followed them on Instagram for a while now. 

The outside seems on the smaller side of things but when you walk in it's dark, romantic, and spacious.

We ended up doing the family meal with the three starters of peri-peri prawns, scallops, and mussels. They were amazing. The prawns were by far my favourite. We also ordered extra of the breads which were phenomenal. 

For dinner we had the lobster risotto with halibut and salmon. Which was unbelievable. 

This is one of our new fav places. Can't wait to go back.
Ate here for the first time. It was delicious. Covid friendly. Service was top notch. Angele was our waitress and  was outstanding. Will be back!

I love this place. Such a welcoming addition to the Donelson side of town. The beers are so well priced and even more delicious. The owner, Pat, is one of the loveliest people in Nashville. The food...is out of this world. My mouth is watering just thinking about it.

This is the best food that I have had in Tampa!!!! Very clean and tidy restaurant. Food is fresh and delicious. Great service. Will definitely keep coming back for more. I hope they extend their hours to close later at 7 or 8 pm, because I would go here everyday if I had the chance!!!
Pizza was very good for delivery , not at all greasy.  Sausage was thin flat slices, but many of them, with a good flavor.  Veggies were scant however.  Overall satisfied.
Great food in the middle of nowhere area of Tucson. I dislike that they no longer offer the eat in area. Hopefully the get back to it. Go here.

Nice ambiance...too bad it was winter...the outdoor seating looking down the street looks very inviting. Wait staff was attentive and helpful and upbeat. I'm not sure it's really that "southern" of food having been in the south many, many times but still tasty. My wife has the pulled pork cheese on pumpernickel that she loved. The creole Caesar salad was more of a spring mix but very nice and the creole tomato coup had just the right amount of heat. I had fries and a crispy Sriracha and sweet coating. Very nice. Fries were not crisp like I like but still okay. Sweet tea was great...not too sweet like most. Prices were mid-range. Not overwhelmed but still a nice visit.

Katie's is always a great place to go for lunch or their Sunday brunch! The "Phase 1" Sunday brunch menu is slightly different (damn you 'Rona!) - picture attached. The Chorizo Bowl (special) is AMAZING!!

So, before I read an article from IndyStar regarding the Peppy's  grill restaurant about two weeks it was my first time ever hearing anything about it. As, many times I've been to Tappers I've never walked around Fountain Square to actual explore the area until Friday Sept. 6th. I ended up going to the restaurant Friday Sept 13th around 2ish for lunch thanks to Red Line. My first thoughts of the restaurant were it's a small diner like with a lot of history in the Fountain Square area. The restaurant does have a new kitchen so their customers wouldn't leave smelling like grease, restaurants opens 24hrs. The servers were very warm, yet very helpful, and more importantly the menu is very affordable. I then returned back to Peppy's Grill for the actual official opening on Saturday Sept 14th. On, the 13th what I had for lunch was a single cheeseburger with ketchup only, and their curly fries. Then, on my 2nd day back at the restaurant around 6ish that evening on the 14th I had a double cheeseburger where I had my cheese melted to my liking, ketchup only on the burger along with curly fries. It was very fulfilling to the last drop. I know the restaurant was working on trying to have beer, and wine inside the restaurant, but Saturday you could order it just outside at the patio during that time. When, I was there they weren't selling alcohol inside had to purchase it outside. During, the official grand re-opening of the restaurant they had live music where to hip DJs were playing th

Tried this for the first time this past weekend. First off, they bring one small basket of chips & one bowl of salsa for 6 people - same size basket they would give 2 people. No extra small plates for us to take a few chips & salsa & then pass on. And no free refills on chips/salsa - $3.99 for another basket! 
Orders are taken & when the food comes out one main order is completely wrong & two sides are wrong. My daughter twice told her all chicken enchiladas but didn't receive that. My daughter just kept what she got because it would have been too long to wait again - waitress said sorry but no offer to replace or at least discount the bill.
No seasonings at all on any of the entrees. The chicken & the steak in the enchiladas was bland. The prices were above average in my opinion - $18.00 for three enchiladas that were understuffed. Also child's meal was $6.00 & didn't include a drink. 
Also the guests at the table near us were complaining about their food - spoke to the owner or manager - they hardly ate any of the food & left. One plate was barely touched. 
For a bill well over $100 with no dessert it was certainly not worth that. We won't be going back.

This wasn't an option, but I do a 4.5. The service and timing of the pizza was amazing! But, the only negative thing about this is that they use so much sauce. I'm not a sauce girl and I don't want to have to separate the sauce and cheese. But otherwise, I highly recommend if you are looking for an family outing.

Love Schlafly! I have never had a bad experience at any of their restaurants. Food is a little pricey, but very good especially in comparison to the food at other breweries. I love that Schlafly also has cider for non-beer drinkers. The Tap Room has exclusive brews on tap that you can't get elsewhere. The outdoor patio is lovely and staff is so friendly and attentive. You can't go wrong. Prior to COVID I also did a brewery tour at the Tap Room which was super cool and informative.

Love this place. Both locations, as both places have a nice patio area. You order first then you get a number and grab a table. The service is great and the food is so yummy. My favorite is the breakfast quesadilla with bacon, come with side of guacamole, sour cream salsa and breakfast potatoes. If you haven't tried their Bloody Mary's then you have to try one, they are so delicious and are served on in schooner with olives, bacon, and celery stick. They have several options for drinks, I love their lates, they make a fancy little design with the froth.

Breakfast Bagel Sandwiches

The Jerusalem egg & cheese is amazing!! I didn't order ahead (just walked up) so I thought I would be waiting awhile. Nope! Pretty quick turnaround. I got mine to-go, but there is a few tables outside. Can't sit inside yet because...Covid.
Food was very good. Outside seating have some mosquitos. I like mojito cocktail the taste so good. I'll be back again!!
Here for visit. Ordered chicken tikka masala to go. It's amazing!!! Please try this dish if you are looking at this comment hahaha

My husband and I had a great dinner at Yum Yum Hot Pot recently. The restaurant was very clean. We received quick and timely service. At this time, AYCE is not being offered. There is a set dinner option for one or two persons.

We decided to go with the dinner for two as it gave us a few more items and the price was better. We each picked out the flavor of broth we wanted. My husband chose the spicy broth and I got the pork broth. We then chose the meat, veggies, seafood, meatballs, noodles and sauces we wanted. 

Within a short amount of time, the food items we ordered was delivered on a mini tram. Our broths were served in a silver pot and placed on the burners on the table.

Once the broths were boiling, we added different items to make our first serving. Both of our broths had a great taste. My husband especially loved the spiciness of the broth he chose.

Whenever our broths were getting low, we were offered more broth for us to continue to cook the remaining items. 

After several refills, we finished all of the food we ordered. 

We thoroughly enjoyed the food and service we received at Yum Yum Hot Pot. We sincerely appreciated we weren't rushed through our dinner.

We're looking forward to the next time we're in the area to return to this great spot for hot pot.

Very disappointed with my experience. I ordered an iced tea and brownie. My iced tea took an absurdly long time to make, especially considering the restaurant was not busy. Sadly I was never served my brownie. I waited for staff to come check up on my table but no one came and I was not able to remind about my brownie. When I was paying the bill they tried to charge me for the brownie I was never served. Honestly would not recommend. From my experience it seems the only thing this restaurant has going for it is the decor.

A hidden gem in Riverview. Great home made sangria. Please call ahead for reservations during the covid. Their food always hits the mark and is tasty!  They are always attentive to their customers but the place can get really busy. We always go to relax and enjoy the beverages.

This place was great! The pictures of the interior drew me in, and we were delighted by that and also by the food. 
The restaurant is in a stunning house, and it's decorated to look rustic and chic. I've never quite seen anything like it but I loved it. 
Service was probably the slowest we had during our trip, but always courteous! 
My girlfriend had the gumbo which she ate quickly which means it was a hit. 
I ordered the shrimp and grits and it was so decadent and just perfect! Easily the best meal I had on the trip; I'm glad we stopped in.
Removed one star for service timing, would do 4.5 stars if I could!
Great food, great music on Saturday night and nice place to dance without it being trashy like most places to go dancing in Tampa.
The food was amazing! Lamb taco, pork taco, veggie taco and quesadilla with homemade cheese! Chef Cristina was there smiling and helping serve guests!

We were just wandering around and happened on this place. It was the best meal we had in New Orleans, hands down. If you eat nothing else you have to eat here. It's changed Mediterranean food for us. I don't think we will ever find it's equivalent; we'll forever rate other Mediterranean places based on it. Everything was amazing! The stuffed grape leaves were grilled! The rice had pomegranate seeds on top. The sweet and savory combo, oh my God, I can't find the words. Just go. You won't regret it.... 
note - they are only open for take out. There is no dining because of pandemic

What an absolute joke of a company. They came out with the chicken sandwich. Had it for 2 days then were out for a week. Then literally got it back for one day! A Tuesday. We're out again by that night. And now they're literally out for 2 MONTHS!!!! HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!! What an absolute JOKE!

The service was decent and honestly I had a lot of people recommended me this restaurant. The entire menu was the least Mexican I've seen yet. The chilè relleno was stuffed with seafood??? The inside was with pepper jack cheese?? The chilé wasn't even cleaned of seeds and every mouthful my friend was eating seeds. The dish I got was carnitas which came with flavorless corn tortillas which were barely heated up. The carnitas were extremely dry and flavorless but boy were they OILY.  I did my best to eat as much I as I could but that was a mistake. A few hours later, I got EXTREMELY SICK from my stomach and I'll leave the details out. The only thing I can say that I liked were the complimentary chips and salsa but the food was extremely disappointing and I'm more upset I spent my hard earned money on food that made me super sick.

This sushi was put together very well! Did not fall apart, seafood fresh and vegetables sliced perfectly. This food
Was fantastic definitely recommend to anyone with a sushi craving !

Food was okay. There was nothing to dislike. The service and food were standard and would e something that brought me back their location. The beer was fairly priced and had many many options to suffice the pickiest.

Excellent pizza, thin crispy crust and homemade sauce. Quality all around. Salad was great, homemade dressing and large. The staff is so friendly and helpful, you never don't have a refill in you cup!
Raj takes great care of our team whenever we turn up at this joint. Ambiance is great, dosas and uttapas are phenomenal. Service is excellent.

This place rocks! My husband and I were at a show at St Pete Opera and we decided to get a late night bite to eat.  I had ahi tuna which was huge and delicious.  I also had a Two Henry's Badd Apple Cider.  Excellent!  My husband had a hamburger with mushrooms.  He loved it!  Service was great and we didn't feel rushed because they are open until midnight.   Check out the extensive list of microbrews.  Tapfinder app has all the details.

One of our favorite restaurants.  The food and drinks are superb.  Andy, one of the bartenders, has a great personality and helped us to find some creative dishes we might not have otherwise tried.  It is really a great place and we totally recommend it.  Try the dynamite scallops for something rich but delicious.

I sat at the sushi bar and got a Shrimp tempura bento. Took 25 minutes to get the food and the tempura was underfried and cold. They gave chinese soy sauce for the sushi. The california roll had generous portions but the krab was wet and not firm. $15 for a cold meal. Portion was okay. Fix your food and your wait staff
Great service, food and atmosphere. Very spread out tables and take covid restrictions seriously.
Amazingly unique dishes and perfect flavours! This place is breakfast redesigned. Chef mauro has built his first gem in Edmonton, looking forward to location number 2

This was an awesome breakfast spot with great coffee. Definitely should make a stop here for breakfast. Their berries and French toast was so good and fluffy and we also got their puffed pancakes were amazing and you'll probably only need the small because they were so filling! They are seriously melt in your mouth good and don't get me started on the potatoes. Stop here it's a must.
I love this place! It's one of my go to restaurants when people come to visit. The ambience is great and everyone is so friendly. There menu changes with the seasons which is nice

Oysters were prepared well. The prime rib was absolutely delicious and perfectly cooked. Only reason I did not give 5 stars is the calamari was a bit bland and overcooked, and the drinks were on the weak side. But overall we had a great meal and the interior was very modern and clean. I recommend!

The menu is different than the usual Lebanese style middle eastern restaurants.   Never realized that Yemeni food could be such a confluence of the African and Indian spices and yet have an identity of its own.   There is something for everyone at Al-Rayan.

My husband and I went to Gusto this afternoon. We had been there several years ago, so this was our second time. What a treat! We were seated immediately and ordered drinks. We asked for some bread and they brought it with a small container of olive oil. We ordered the bruschetta appetizer, Chicken Giovanni and Meatball Ricotta. Everything was delicious. The bruschetta was on rustic, toasted bread and the tomato and basil tasted freshly picked. The dressing was so, so good. I could have eaten it straight out of the bowl. Our entrees were served at just the right time. We had enough time to finish and enjoy our appetizer. The Meatball Ricotta was tasty and the portion was huge. My husband enjoyed it. My chicken was absolutely scrumptious, tender and juicy and the sauce that was drizzled over it was delicious as well. The chef even made me a small side of  pasta in a light butter sauce, because I am not a fan of rice pilaf, which came with my meal. Overall, I would give Gusto more than 5 stars, but it's the highest you can go. From the staff, ambience, wait time, quality and taste of the food, Gusto is top notch. I am glad we came back and we will definitely be coming back in the near future. Highly Recommend!

Great local teriyaki chain. I usually go to the new location by BSU, but figured I would try this location. I called ahead to order. My go to is the chicken teriyaki with half rice and half broccoli. The chicken has a lot of flavor. The chicken breast isn't bad, but after you have chicken thighs, you'll never want to go back to chicken breast. Portions are large. Service has been good every time I've been. 

The only downside is not all the locations use the same rewards program. The location by BSU has a different one than the Eagle location.

I had an excellent experience recently at Drunken Fish CWE. Covid protections were in place- masks, tables at a distance and someone friendly explaining what is new and taking temperatures of guests. All the staff was friendly and attentive and wearing masks. Everything I ordered was as delicious as always. I got an opportunity to leave feedback on a card to provide input for their ever changing dining experience which considers diner preferences as well as CDC guidelines to provide the best and safest dining experience. I opted to leave some feedback and even got an email from the manager thanking me for doing so and for my business. I highly recommend this place.

Easily the worst taco Bell in the city. Workers are slow, inattentive, lazy, and rude. Avoid at all costs. Have been here 3 times and never had a good experience. I now go to the location three times further away bc the service is miles better

I LOVE Mexican food and have been looking for a go-to restaurant in/near Indy, and I've finally found it! The service was really fast, atmosphere enjoyable, and the food was delicious. The chips and salsa were top notch, which I'm usually critical about in my quest for authentic Mexican food. I had a margaritas and the pastor tacos. Can't wait to go back!

I decided to try out this place due to the favorable reviews and I was deeply disappointed. The chicken chow mein lunch combo was definitely not what I expected. It was served with packaged chow mein crackers and not the usual noodles. The combo also came with pork fried rice and wonton soup. Both of these items were very bland. The food is still edible if you must eat here but I wouldn't recommend it.

Seriously disappointing.  That is the executive summary, no burying the lede here...read on, though, if you're so inclined.  

As Charlie Brown's sister Sally famously said when she skipped Halloween and accompanied Linus to the Pumpkin Patch on that ill-fated eve to meet the Great Pumpkin and be showered with gifts:

I was robbed! I spent the whole night waiting for the Great Pumpkin when I could have been out for tricks or treats!

So, too, did I feel today upon receiving my $26 chicken Pho from BT to GO!!!!! ($17 for the Pho, plus delivery, plus tip...).  Before I go into the details, let me assure you of 2 things:  I have had a LOT of Pho all over the world but specifically here in the Tampa Bay.

Let's start with the good: ordering via UberEats was super easy.  From the time I place the order to delivery was around 40 minutes - pretty impressive!   The quantity was large.

Ok, now let's get real, folks.  First, upon opening the bag, I was surprised to see that there was no bowl, per se (see photo).  Broth in a high-topped container (chicken in same broth).  Noddle packed into a smaller container- and I mean PACKED to the top.  I could not pour the broth and chicken over the noodles - no room - and adding the noodles to the high-topped container?  First, awkward to eat and second, really - no room.  A fairly thoughtless preparation.  Fortunately, I was at work and found a tupperware bowl in the breakroom...there it is.

Ok, now to the Pho.  It was BLAND!  Very few herbs.

Was walking by and realized their upper deck patios were open and decided to stop in for a few drinks. 

Brandon, and I cannot remember his friends name were both wonderful host, in my case bartenders. Brandon if you remember me you called me "Jacob" from California.

I forgot to take pictures of the other drinks ( bummer) but Brandon made sure we were taking care of us. He made us feel at home very comfortable share some of his experiences about NOLA he loves!
Would probably be good when drunk. But pretty mediocre at best besides that. Crust wasn't great.

This is our favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara. We love the soups and salads. They also have some great specials. Everything is fresh. Sitting outside for lunch on a sunny day on State Street is fun.
Order at the counter and get a number and find a table. We recently ordered a dish we didn't like and they very graciously have us a replacement!  We would eat there every day if we could.

Service at the bar was dubious at best. They weren't busy but they didn't get my order right, too fast and wrong temp on steak.  It came medium well instead of medium rare.  Oops.  The corrected steak tasted funny, like they used liquid smoke or something.  I could only eat half it was kind of nasty.  It cost me over $100 for just me (with drinks), at that price point I expect better.  I won't be back.

This restaurant has great food and my husband and I will definitely order from here again. I had the sweet and sour chicken with pork fried rice. My husband had sesame chicken with pork fried rice. Both came with egg rolls and as an appetizer we got teriyaki spare ribs (I think). All the food we had was delicious and the order said an hour but was delivered in 30 minutes!

So the food was really good and that's why the 4 stars. Staff was super friendly and service was fast. The place it self is not clean. Bathrooms were so dirty and gross. Place is in a time warp as far as not being updated. It's also very dark inside and a little depressing.

I've been going to Engimono for years. It's a great sushi place in the Fairmount area. It's fresh and nicely prepared. Last night, I ordered the udon noodle soup, and it was bland. Honestly, it tasted worse than vegetable udon I make at home. However, my partner enjoyed her tofu teriyaki. The flavors were good and the tofu consistency was remarkable. Overall, I recommend getting the sushi or teriyaki. Do not get the noodle soup; they have much better items.

This has to be the slowest "fast food" location on the face of the planet. I mean they are ssssssssssllllllllllllllllllooooooooooooooooowwwwwwwwwwwww. Ray Kroc and the McDonald brothers would be spinning in their grave if they saw how slow this location was.

We had Lamb shank, Diver scallops, rabbit Cacciatore, Char grilled Octopus, Mozz di Buffalo & Mushroom Riviolo.
Octopus and Mozz were the best, rest of food was average.

Wings and meatballs are so good, everything there is delicious, Delivery people were so nice and grateful.  He kept thanking me for the business.  To go order was great, exact and on time.  Just love this food and place

I'm so happy we went here for our anniversary! The atmosphere was so romantic and friendly service from the moment we walked in. We had a phenomenal server who made our night even better. Our server, Jonathan, convinced us to try the tasting menu. We are so happy we did. He was so knowledgeable and walked us through the ENTIRE menu. He helped us with our drink selections too! We cannot wait to come back!!

Foods very good and consistent quality. I come here often with my husband and it is always a fun atmosphere. Today I sat at the bar and I understand the bar was crowded, but we didn't receive menus and sat there for a good 10 minutes waiting. Other than the wait, service was good, but slow. They should consider having at least 2 bar tenders on during sporting events that they will broadcast.

We hired Cafe A La Cart to cater our wedding in Tucson. They did an AMAZING job!! The food was absolutely incredible - we got a LOT of compliments. The servers were friendly and professional, and everything flowed smoothly. And that's not to mention the unbelievable buttermilk-berry cake!! Wow!!!!

We really appreciate all the work that Cafe A La Cart did for us, and we're so happy we chose them for our big day.

I went to this Chick fil A drive thru for dinner one night and the line was impossibly long - everyone up until the two people in the line next to me were taking turns merging into one lane. As soon as it was my turn the two cars next to me gunned it and cut me off, almost got into an accident. It was very frustrating. I'm not sure if that is the reason why but I'm guessing one of the workers here saw it happen and they brought my food out before I was even at the window. It made an almost terrible experience into a really nice one so thank you. I appreciate it.

I've ordered from here several times and while I like their food I wont be coming back. I live a few blocks away and when my food is "done" and I leave my house to pick it up it up it always ends up being another 10-25 minutes after I walk in when their website tells me my food is done. This last time I ordered the website told me it was done and they hadn't even started making it yet. I get it sometimes things can be slow but this is every time I order

Mel's diner was very family friendly, staff was very  welcoming and on top of our orders . Establishment was clean , food was great with lots of choices to keep my 3 kids happy ! We will definitely eat here again. The decor all around the diner makes it feel old school !
Wings and steak sandwich were just right.  Shrimp were fried properly but smallish.  Overall they know hot oil.

If I could give no stars, that would be my top option. The food here is TERRIBLE!! My experience in Atlanta was totally different. I went for a birthday dinner on canal st. last night and my party of 4 was disappointed. The food was disgusting. The meat was not cooked all the way. We asked for well done and each item came back medium rare, every time. The streak, lamb and even the chicken was pink in the middle. Then, after we got the  bill, I put $400 in cash on the table and walked out. These idiots CHASED US to the door because they ASSUMED we didn't pay. Smh. I will never visit this restaurant again. Straight up nasty, and the service does not equate to the prices. Shame on you Fogo Nola!!!!!!

Very authentic, delicious food. We've been to other Indian places in Center City/University City and this is definitely one of the best. The buffet is no frills but the food was fresh and delicious. The owner (I think) came out and served us fresh naan and dosa as he brought it out for the buffet, and was very friendly to us and all the other patrons. Also very reasonably priced.
This place is SO good! I tried their breakfast at the farmers market and I can't wait to visit their store front next week for some tamales. 3 in 1 deserves all the chefs kisses from me!!!

Wonderful dinning experience. The restaurant is very nice and food is wonderful. I had the chicken & andouille gumbo. It is a small serving but the flavor is so rich that I could not eat a bigger portion of it. Creamy grits are very good as well. I also ordered the Ham with peach and fresh cheese, absolutely fantastic. The service was great, the bread and butter as so yummy! I was so pleased with my dinner.

Is great if you're a full-time and have no time to meal prep or don't known how to cook. All the meals are portioned and taste great. I currently have the 5 keto meal plan I've lost consistently lost 25lbs sticking to the meal regiment and eat clean you will lose weight and obtain your goals. Not only eat great but feel great energized but a Crunch membership is included why not join Eat Right.  LIFE now

I like the casino better than the strip
8/24 at night around 1:00 am while waiting for my company, I parked at the back of the hotel
so it will be quite the security kicked me out of the place. I told him I tried to book a room but 
the placed was fully booked so I decided to napped until my company arrived. Still insist for me to leave
He's rude, I like the casino but not the security 
who is very inconsiderate
Delicious southern food and cool atmosphere! A little walk from "downtown" but worth it!

This establishment is absolutely horrible and extremely rude staff and owner. All I know personally, is the food is soggy and the owner likes to try an ruin other people's names instead of worrying about his own company that's FAILING. Think how big of a man baby this is to of said what they said below...

Seis is, by far, one of the best restaurants in Tucson. I would highly suggest getting their shrimp tacos. You can special request that they be battered versus grilled. My husband and I have been going there for years and they agree to make this special order every time.

For this transplanted Texan, it feels like I just wandered into a BBQ oasis! The style of BBQ here is more central California than central Texas, but this is the best I've found in Treasure Valley. The TriTip sandwich here is perfection between two slices of rustic garlic bread. Two options for sauce: a regular and a spicy; both are excellent. I blended the two and savored it. Service was friendly and helpful. Not kidding; if you're searching for a BBQ fix, look no further. Very charming, bodacious decor complete w/chandelier in old downtown Eagle. Really happy to have found this Pig!

The ambiance here is great and the staff is so friendly! We came here pre-covid and we absolutely loved it!

The food was all so amazing. Everything was delicious. My only complaint is that the portions are so small, yet so expensive. My boyfriend and I spent nearly $140 on two orders of fondue, 2 entrees, and a dessert fondue. We recreated this meal at home for $70 and we served 5 people with the amount of food we bought...

SO, while the food here is very good, I really don't think it's worth the price. Definitely a fun place to go to if you have the money, though!

Cybil had heard about EDGE Brewing from a Facebook post saying it was rated in The 50 Best Places To Eat Chicken Wings In The USA (https://bigseventravel.com/2019/04/chicken-wings-america/), so we decided to give it a try during their Wing Wednesday which offers 1/2 off on all wings and boneless baskets for $6.  We were not disappointed.

EDGE Brewing is located in an industrial park, and as we pulled up I was a little worried we may be eating in a warehouse.  Instead we found a space that was open, inviting, and beautifully furnished and decorated including artwork by a local artist.

Cybil opted for 10 bone-in wings with Bacon Balsamic and Peanut Butter Hot sauces.  I went for the basket of boneless wings served over fries with Ginger Habanero and Blackwater BBQ sauces.

The only disappointment was my boneless wings which reminded me of Chicken McNuggets, but in fairness to EDGE, our server had warned me that would be the case.  Everything else was *amazing*.

Our server Paige was wonderful, eagerly making recommendations and also running reconnaissance missions when we saw other amazing food being served at other tables and wondered what it was.

Our total tab came to $19.78 including adult beverages for two people and tax, an incredible bargain.  We can't wait to come back again.

I'm staying in Tampa for the summer, so you better believe I'm here for the food scene. Luckily, I happened to be in the mood for some noodles and came across this small joint barely a block from my summer apartment. And let me just say, this place is completely underrated. 

It may not seem like some fancy restaurant on the outside (or the inside for that matter) but upon entering the restaurant, the smell of some good home cooking hits you like wall. My boyfriend and I were in the mood for a good meaty broth with noodles. We ordered ourselves some scallion pancakes to start off and then we got the Beef noodle soup. 

The scallion pancakes (which I'll admit, I wasn't too excited for to begin with) were the perfect prerequisite to our hot soup. They were crispy and lightly oiled, with just the right amount of salty goodness. 

As for the soup... it was AMAZING! The noodles were handmade, and you truly appreciated their imperfections for they made them taste THAT much better. The broth was pleasantly spicy and hearty with deliciously tender beef slices mixed in the savory goodness. Overall, great place! I'd definitely come again, just so I can try the PIZZA. Yes, it's called Mei's Pizza after all. This place amazes me even more, can't wait to experience it again.

Really outstanding happy hour! Great, well measured drinks at the bar, and $6 appetizers that are full size. The tandori chicken poutine is  creative comfort food, and is perfect to share of drinks. Also tried the nachos -- really great chips, with a wonderful mix of veggies and meat, overall outstanding. We shared both, and might give a slight edge to the nachos. But it's oh so close. Must also say, best old fashioned in town! Such a great place, really a must visit while in town!
I looooove this place!!! They finally brought one to Tucson!!! Pick your salad toppings, dressing and go!!! Customized salads yummy dressings.

Right of the bat I can say the service is amazing. The Waiters are always super nice and attentive. And the food is bursting with flavor. I would recommend this place if you love a fine dining environment.
Long waits if you do not have a reservation BUT, the best lasagna I have ever had. So worth the wait. Have a glass of wine and enjoy!
Originally from New Orleans, tho now living in san jose. Just discovered these guys last month. The bun was good. Their baked meat pies were fantastic. Latter is from the bakery section.

this is a cute little bakery that offers lunch items as well! its cute and cozy inside with a friendly staff! difficult to find parking sometimes on a busy day but its worth a walk down the street! highly recommend the lemon bars and the opera cake! the opera cake was to die for while the lemon bars were good but a little too rich!

Had an incredible experience! First time patron to Fat Salmon and won't be last. The rolls selection was diverse and inventive. The quality was top notch and the service was attentive. Highly recommend all around.
